adversarial_review: A real recorded continuation is not the only acceptable utterance. Topic, personal content and conversational context can cause recognition effects without style fidelity. Eight speakers form only four reciprocal dependence clusters. The primary endpoint can measure actual-reference selection, not causal speaker-style isolation, relevance, truth or dialogue quality. Both option orders expose superficial letter preference; exact matching and invalid-selection missingness avoid silent semantic repairs.

future_decision_heuristic.GO_development_replication: Only with complete format coverage, positive CORRECT-MISMATCH and CORRECT-NONE, all leave-one-pair-out means positive for both, and CORRECT candidate invariance no worse than NONE. This is a conservative future allocation heuristic, not a calibrated test, confidence claim or historical qualification threshold.
future_decision_heuristic.PIVOT_measurement: If changes are dominated by format failure or letter preference, investigate option stability rather than call the effect Persona Fidelity.
future_decision_heuristic.PIVOT_interference: If only mismatched history harms recognition, consider a separately frozen topic/content-controlled development test; do not jump to algorithm novelty.
future_decision_heuristic.STOP_expansion: Control or safety gate failure, or no stable history benefit with no distinct mechanism worth testing. Preserve results and do not retry, tune these cases, or open58 validation speakers.
future_decision_heuristic.validation: No automatic independent validation. Freeze construct-valid configuration and sample rationale separately before considering reserved speakers. At least512 generation requests remain if all52 are attempted.
